examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?

examples.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
examples.english: How about checking under the sofa?

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。

items.wordHook: a 丆(cliff edge) presses a 囬(striped box) flat on one 面(side).

items.wordHook: Combining 布(cloth) and 置(lay out): 布置 means fix up.

items.wordHook: 下(down) + 雪(snow): snow coming down means "to snow".
a 口(mouth) shape stands pierced by one straight stroke through its middle → the exact 中(central) point.
女(female) + 兒(child) → a female child, your daughter.
Combining 抵(resist) and 達(reach): 抵達 means arrive.
Ready to 挑(select) tough opponents in courageous 戰(war) competition: 挑戰 means challenge.
a 扌(hand) takes the 荅(answer) seat → ready to 搭(take) the train.
To 教(education) a 學(learn): 教學 means teach.
A fierce 爫(claw) grabs a broom コ(snout) past 一(one) line to pull the 亅(hook), sparking a bitter 爭(dispute).
a 艹(grass) stem rests by the 闌(screen door) → one rare 蘭(orchid).
Combining 行(walk) and 程(journey): 行程 means schedule, itinerary.
A 言(speech) plus a 殳(tool) means to build: you talk a plan into shape with a tool.
Combining 身(body) and 邊(border): 身邊 means at one's side.
a 豆(beans) basket sits above the 頁(head) → balanced on your 頭(head).
